column1: # Live-state topics (scripts/live-collect.py). Columns, tab separated: topic, words of the `hs sys` read, interval in seconds,
# while the storage is locked: run|skip. The row is in the table `live` of the state database (key = topic).
# The `live` topic reads `hs sys live status`; it sees its own previous document because the collector runs the command before it takes
# its own database write. This means the `live` row is one collection behind, which is expected, not staleness.
# Fixed storage reads: a topic holds the output of exactly one `hs sys` invocation. Pool reads with a fixed `pool=bulk|fast` argument
# are mapped per request in web-serve.py; other pool names and no pool stay direct reads.
# Columns 5 and 6: cap = the capability that must be on for the topic to run (`-` = always; a topic whose cap is off is not run and has no
# document); groups = comma list of change areas (registry `topic:` words, ext-<name>) whose change wakes the topic, `-` = none. A refresh
# `@<group>` wakes every topic that lists the group or the group `any`; `*` wakes all.
# Column 7: needs = comma list of topics (column 1 of this file) whose new gen re-reads this topic in a wave
# (scripts/live-collect.py), `-` = none. Checked by tests/live-state-test.py (unknown topic, self reference, cycle fail).
# Column 8 (optional): ttl = seconds the entry counts as fresh (live_state.status_of); `-` or empty = 3 x interval. An entry past its ttl is still served, only marked.
# Column 9 (optional): demand (D14) = `always` (or empty, `-`: the topic runs at its interval) or `idle:<seconds>`: the topic runs at its interval only
# while an open page of the web interface wants it (a lease in the table `demand`, written by hs-web), else once per idle period, and at once when a
# lease appears. Every topic whose document only a page reads. Never a topic named in health-check.sh or lib/notify-rules.tsv, and never a read
# whose script may write events or notifications (ALWAYS_TOPICS in tests/live-demand-test.py). A named event or a refresh by hook still wakes it.
# Lock mode: mounted-pool/Samba reads skip while locked (they need services that are down); lock-aware reads run so the UI can show
# the defined locked state. Unlock refreshes all topics immediately.
